title: Chalo Hussain se Ehd e Wafaa nibhana hai
body:
CHALO HUSSAIN SE EHD E WAFA NIBHANA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
Zehra se kiya tha jo wada wo wada Hum ne nibhana Hai...
<<MINI>>
Chalo Hussain se Ehd e Wafaa nibhana hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bas ab kahi bhi nahi karbala ko jana hai
1) Main is jahaan me aate hi pehle roya Hoon...
Main chashme namm se musalsall jo aaj Goya hoon
Gham e Hussain se rishta bohot puraana hai
<<MINI>>
Chalo Hussain se Ehd e wafaa nibhana hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Nafas Nafas me mere dil ka chain Zinda hai
Har aek sans me naam e Hussain zinda hai
Bas ab lahu ki rawaani ko aazmana hai
<<MINI>>
Chalo Hussain se Ehd e Wafaa nibhana hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Humari rooh ka Dil ka hai nainawa maskann
Azal se shah ka thaame hue hain hum Daman
Jo ab ki baar gaye laut kar na aana hai
<<MINI>>
Chalo Hussain se Ehd e Wafaa nibhana hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Likha hai ism e khuda e wafaa mein naam tera
Jo zaayero'n ka muhafiz nazar nahi aata
Wo hum safar hai to phir aur kya bahana hai
<<MINI>>
Chalo Hussain se Ehd e Wafaa nibhana hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
5) ziyarat e Shahe Mazloom ka nahi hai jawaab
Hazaar rah e Khuda me jehaad ka hai sawaab
Jazaa e khair e amall Shahedeen se paana hai...
<<MINI>>
Chalo Hussain se Ehd e Wafaa nibhana hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
6) gunaahgar sifaarish ko 100 jo aenge
Jo Zayereen hai wo unko bakhwaenge
Jo eqtiyaar hai mehsharr me wo dikhaana hai
<<MINI>>
Chalo Hussain se Ehd e Wafaa nibhana hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
7) zaarih e shah pa aate hai khud Imam e zama'an
Tumhare dil mein hai gar un ki deed ka aarma'n
To jaanlo ke tumhe sar ke bal hi Jaana hai
<<MINI>>
Chalo Hussain se Ehd e Wafaa nibhana hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
8) padhegi khaak kisi par jo paa e zaayer ki... To usko Aag jahannum ki chu na paaegi..
Chalo najaat ka karbobala thikaana hai..
<<MINI>>
Chalo Hussain se Ehd e Wafaa nibhana hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
9) Dua karo yahi Farhaan Shah e waala se...
Namaz e Ishq ke dar par qubool ho sajde..
Dar e Hussain pa Saadiq ko sar jhukaana hai...
<<MINI>>
Chalo Hussain se Ehd e Wafaa nibhana hai.
